camel_example: aliyun sas GetSwitchRegionDetail --region cn-hangzhou --Type sg_switch --Lang en
description_en: Queries the progress of a service switchover. For example, when a server connection is being migrated from China to Singapore, this operation retrieves the migration progress and status
description_zh: 查询服务切换的进度。如：服务器的连接从中国迁移到新加坡的过程中，获取迁移进度、状态等信息
